units.source_text: 他用说话的语调诵这诗句。

en.t: He recited these lines in a conversational tone.

units.source_text: 二女公子看见这人貌似她的薄情郎，可以当作那人看待，

en.t: The second young lady saw that this man looked like her faithless lover, and could regard him as that very man,

units.source_text: 然而终于未便直接唱和，便叫弁君传言道：

en.t: yet in the end it was not convenient to answer him directly in verse, so she had Ben no Kimi convey these words:
